npm.verification: registry metadata, exact version, integrity and license

url.verification: official URL reachability, exact revision, license and response identity

api.requirement: a registered host adapter must return concrete resource identity, license, version and integrity before selection

mcp.requirement: an available MCP tool must return concrete resource identity, license, version and integrity before selection

skill.requirement: Skills may rank or describe candidates but cannot materialize a runtime asset without an executable resolver

official-site.requirement: manual browsing is discovery evidence only until converted to npm, URL or a registered host adapter
